title: Versioned Serialization for R Objects
text: rdz writes reads R objects versioned, seekable, checksummed block container. Common objects stored natively, column column block block, compressed Zstandard pool threads; everything else goes R’s serializer, streamed blocks. Native: logical, integer, double character vectors, factors, lists data frames (data.table tibble included), nested, attributes: names, classes, Date’s POSIXct’s metadata, matrix’s dimensions. vector picks block records (runs, frame reference, delta, byte planes, sparse bitplane logicals, string dictionaries). Generic: anything else, environments, closures, calls, complex raw vectors, S4 objects, goes R serialization one whole root, sharing references kept. Selective: read_rdz(path, select = , rows = ) reads columns data frame elements list, rows data frame elements vector, decoding blocks need. Inspectable: rdz_schema() shows native file’s tree (part’s type, class, shape, attributes size), rdz_attributes(path, object = c("sales", "date")) reads part’s attributes, without decoding data. Content-addressed: every file records 128-bit hash value (rdz_info(path)$content_hash, read without data), rdz_hash(x) gives hash object, whatever compression level, threads platform. write_rdz(skip_unchanged = TRUE) leaves file holding value , rdz_verify() checks file’s integrity without building . Compact graphs: large vector appears twice object stored read back shared, pickle Kryo . Archives: rdz_save(, b, file = ) rdz_load(file, names = "b") work save() load() , load objects named. memory: rdz_serialize(x) gives bytes raw vector (Redis, database, socket) rdz_unserialize() reads back; every reader takes raw vector takes path. Self-describing: write_rdz(x, path, metadata = c(source = "...")) records key-value strings rdz_info() reads without data. Tables written: data.tables come back usable place, nested , tibbles tibbles. Checked: every header, directory block carries XXH3-64 checksum, every length offset bounded anything allocated. Portable: files byte-identical every platform, little- big-endian alike.

text: First release. file format frozen version: every later rdz reads files writes (?rdz, “Compatibility”).
